title: Event Textures
description: This reshourchepacks just re-textures some gui and blocks u can use in ur events! (not recommended to use in survival worlds)
body:
Hello, This is reshourchepack i needed myself... so i guess i will just make it public! i made this for my event since i felt like it was needed, i plan on adding more blocks and more in the feature. **i also appriciate it if u guys can give me ideas for blocks, (must be a not used block :P)** so i can update my reshourchepack! **(request things in the discord server)**

1. **Loom: Event Block.**
2. **Jigsaw Block: Money.**
3. **Structure Block: Cookie Block.**
4. **Leave Button: "Leave Event"** (adding later)
